hero.subtitle_zh: 每一台电脑，都是不可复制的艺术品

heritage.zh: 入行电脑硬件改装领域，从第一台DIY水冷主机起步，开启手工定制之路。
heritage.en: Entered the PC hardware modding scene. Started with the first DIY water-cooled build, embarking on a journey of handcrafted customization.

heritage.zh: 入驻斗鱼直播，向全网展示水冷改装全过程，积累首批忠实粉丝。
heritage.en: Joined Douyu live streaming, showcasing the entire water-cooling modding process to a nationwide audience, building the first wave of loyal followers.

heritage.zh: 骨伽征服者主题定制作品问世，标志性设计语言初步成型，引发行业关注。
heritage.en: The Cougar Conquer themed custom build debuted, establishing the signature BRO design language and drawing industry-wide attention.

heritage.zh: 自研电离子发光技术；Z-Tower Storm 横空出世，20万级旗舰奠定行业地位。
heritage.en: Developed proprietary Electro-Ion Luminescence technology. The Z-Tower Storm emerged, a ¥200K flagship that defined BRO's position in the industry.

heritage.zh: 全国送机行启动，足迹覆盖北上广深等十余城，亲手将每台作品交付客户。
heritage.en: Launched the Nationwide Delivery Tour, covering over ten cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen — personally delivering each masterpiece to its owner.

heritage.zh: BRO Atelier 正式品牌化，每台作品署名认证，作品馆累计收录50+独创方案。
heritage.en: BRO Atelier officially launched as a brand. Every build now comes with a signed certificate. The Atelier has accumulated 50+ original designs.

commission.desc_zh: 在线提交您的定制需求，包括预算范围、机箱偏好、主题风格和使用场景。我们将在24小时内与您取得联系。
commission.desc_en: Submit your custom requirements online, including budget, case preference, theme, and usage scenario. We will contact you within 24 hours.

commission.desc_zh: BRO Atelier 设计师根据需求出3D渲染方案，包含水路布局、灯光系统与主题涂装。方案确认后进入制作排期。
commission.desc_en: BRO Atelier designers produce a 3D render proposal, covering the liquid loop layout, lighting system, and themed finish. Production scheduling begins upon approval.

commission.desc_zh: 全部手工打造，从水道板CNC加工到硬管弯折、灯光编程，制作周期约4-8周，全程同步进度照片。
commission.desc_en: Entirely hand-built — from CNC-machined distribution plates to hard-tube bending and lighting programming. Production takes approximately 4-8 weeks with progress photos shared throughout.

commission.desc_zh: 48小时烤机测试通过后，全国送机上门或顺丰保价发货。附赠BRO署名认证证书及终身售后保障。
commission.desc_en: After passing a 48-hour stress test, we deliver nationwide in person or via SF Express insured shipping. Includes a BRO signed certificate and lifetime after-sales support.

form.contact_ph_zh: 微信 / 手机 / 邮箱

form.vision_ph_en: Describe your desired case, theme, lighting, usage scenario, etc.

events.meta_zh: 上海新国际博览中心 · 2024.07.26-29 · 3台作品展出
events.meta_en: Shanghai New Int'l Expo Center · 2024.07.26-29 · 3 Builds Exhibited
events.desc_zh: Z-Tower Storm 领衔亮相，电离子发光技术首次公开展示，吸引数万观众驻足体验。
events.desc_en: Z-Tower Storm headlined the exhibition. Electro-Ion Luminescence technology made its public debut, drawing tens of thousands of visitors.

events.meta_zh: 北上广深等十余城市 · 2024全年 · 20+台交付
events.desc_zh: BRO 亲自驾车巡回全国，亲手将每一台水冷大作交付客户，现场安装调试，留下无数精彩瞬间。
events.desc_en: BRO personally drove across the country, hand-delivering each liquid-cooled masterpiece with on-site installation and tuning.

events.desc_zh: 首届 BRO 社区线下聚会，改装同好携爱机齐聚，交流水路设计、灯光方案与主题创意。
events.desc_en: The first BRO community offline gathering. Modding enthusiasts brought their builds to exchange loop designs, lighting concepts, and creative themes.

events.meta_zh: 斗鱼 / Bilibili 直播间 · 持续更新
events.desc_zh: 每场直播中的精彩片段：硬管弯折教学、灯光编程幕后、装机翻车与救场瞬间，真实记录创作过程。
events.desc_en: Memorable moments from every livestream: hard-tube bending tutorials, lighting programming behind-the-scenes, and real-time build recovery.

news.desc_zh: Z-Tower Storm 亮相上海ChinaJoy，现场展示电离子发光技术，吸引数万观众驻足。
news.desc_en: Z-Tower Storm debuted at Shanghai ChinaJoy, showcasing Electro-Ion Luminescence technology to tens of thousands of visitors.

news.title_zh: O11D EVO 全视界水冷方案发布
news.title_en: O11D EVO Panoramic Water Cooling Launched
news.desc_zh: 全新Lian Li O11D EVO定制方案上线，支持双360冷排+水道板一体化设计。
news.desc_en: The new Lian Li O11D EVO custom solution is now available, featuring dual 360 radiators and an integrated distribution plate design.

news.desc_zh: 新一轮全国送机行五一启动，首站杭州，BRO亲自驾车护送三台作品交付客户。
news.desc_en: The new Nationwide Delivery Tour kicked off on May 1st, starting in Hangzhou. BRO personally drove to deliver three masterpieces to their owners.

care.desc_zh: 所有BRO Atelier出品的水冷系统享受终身技术支持与维护服务。非人为损坏免费维修。
care.desc_en: All BRO Atelier liquid cooling systems enjoy lifetime technical support and maintenance. Free repairs for non-user-induced damage.

care.desc_zh: 国内主要城市提供亲自送机上门服务，现场安装调试，确保每一台作品完美运行。
care.desc_en: In-person delivery and on-site setup available in major cities across China, ensuring every masterpiece runs perfectly from day one.

care.desc_zh: 专属客服一对一响应，工作时间内2小时回复。紧急情况提供远程视频诊断支持。
care.desc_en: Dedicated 1-on-1 customer support with a 2-hour response time during business hours. Remote video diagnostics available for emergencies.
